items.title: Rosbag Resurrector — a pandas-like analysis + ML-export workbench for ROS 2 bags
items.summary: Hi all — I’ve been building rosbag-resurrector, an analysis workbench for ROS 2 (MCAP) bags. It’s deliberately not another 3D viewer — it treats a bag like a DataFrame: pandas-like access, a DuckDB index across many bags, health/QC validation, semantic frame search, cross-bag overlay, and one-command export to LeRobot / RLDS / Parquet.
